title: Patent US10,123,456: Selective ROCK2 inhibitors for treatment of fibrotic diseases
body: This patent discloses selective ROCK2 inhibitors, including NX-14, for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and other fibrotic conditions. The claims cover composition of matter, methods of treatment, and pharmaceutical formulations. Claims extend to 2042. Patent covers the use of compounds with IC50 <100 nM for ROCK2 and >500 nM for ROCK1. This patent establishes intellectual property but does not constitute clinical evidence of efficacy.
